question: Test signed cut balance as a robust half-transfer guard and discriminate aggregate from sector-resolved transfer.

objects.definition: (direct squared stock minus source squared stock) divided by initial total stock
objects.domain: real finite-dimensional two-port state with nonzero stock
objects.origin: candidate observable using sourced incidence balance

assumptions: Real Euclidean source and direct ports with closed skew exchange and nonzero source-only initial stock.
Shared continuous positive rate for the half-transfer theorem. Separate sector rates for the counterexample.
Additive normalized balance error with amplitude and derivative bounds over a declared bracket.

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: bounded error margins and sector identifiability

integer_fraction_receipt.raw_count_expression: equal-stock average of sector fractions 1/4 and 3/4

clock_receipt.coupling: shared positive rate or split-rate falsifier

dynamics_readout.state_space: two Euclidean real ports, optional sector decomposition
dynamics_readout.generator_or_update: x prime=-omega y, y prime=omega x
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: C conserved; signed J crosses cut
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: aggregate stock can conceal opposite sector deviations

fitted_parameters_or_formula_choices: rational bracket controls and split-rate witness
target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: closed shared-phase model, bounded observation error, split-rate counterexample
target_exposure.selection_criterion: transversal half-stock trigger with sector scope

calculation_steps: Derive lower crossing slope and fraction error

result.precision_and_error: analytic bounds and exact Fraction controls
result.scope: Common positive phase gives an exact transversal half split. Observation error epsilon bounds fraction error by epsilon/2 in a certified bracket. Unsynchronized sector rates give a transversal aggregate zero at fractions 1/4 and 3/4.

counterexamples_and_failures: Flux is positive at half transfer; endpoint zeros do not select half
Aggregate balance does not imply sector balance
limitations: Same ports and latch must be sourced
No general perturbed-generator claim beyond common rate and additive observation model
Second-stage depletion and deficit allocation open
next_discriminant: Derive or test shared phase or sector-resolved cut latches in a native interaction, then source depletion separately.
